name: subagent-cockpit-mcp
description: MCP server that delegates tasks to external coding agents over the Agent Client Protocol
author: yejianfei.billy

scripts.build: webpack --mode production && tsc src/types.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --target ES2022 --module ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --strict --skipLibCheck
scripts.webui:mock: npm run build && node --import tsx mock/webui.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/adapter/adapter.test.ts test/session/session-store.test.ts test/session/session-manager.test.ts test/server.test.ts test/cli.test.ts test/lint-boundary.test.ts test/webui/transcript.test.ts test/webui/webui.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:codex: npm run build && playwright test --project=e2e test/specs/e2e/codex.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:claude: npm run build && playwright test --project=e2e test/specs/e2e/claude.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:grok: npm run build && playwright test --project=e2e test/specs/e2e/grok.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:opencode: npm run build && playwright test --project=e2e test/specs/e2e/opencode.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:antigravity: npm run build && playwright test --project=e2e test/specs/e2e/antigravity.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:concurrent: npm run build && playwright test --project=e2e test/specs/e2e/concurrent.spec.ts
